name: evo-skillopt
description: Text-space skill optimization for production LLM agents, callable over HTTP. Evolves a bot's Markdown skill file against a held-out eval set with git-tracked audit trails.

endpoints.purpose: run one SkillOpt training pass against a bot's skill + eval set
aggregate and gate a pipeline of pre-scored skills
reduce Acquire/Retain/Monetize signals to one composite fitness

concepts.skill: A Markdown document specifying what a bot does, how, and what it must never do. The learnable parameter.
concepts.evolution: One full training cycle: rollout -> reflect -> aggregate -> select -> update -> gate.
concepts.gate: A hard validation check. A proposed skill diff must beat the eval score by at least gate_min_improvement.
concepts.rrss: Four-axis resilience gate: Robustify, Reliabilify, Solidify, Stabilize.
concepts.cascade: An ordered list of skills treated as one behavior contract; each stage must clear a per-stage floor plus an aggregate threshold.
concepts.arm: Three-bucket signal classifier: Acquire, Retain, Monetize. Reduces heterogeneous production signals to one lifecycle-weighted fitness.
